outline.name: DRUNKEN BRIDGE HILL, (East side (off)) Plympton, Hardwick Dovecote at Hardwick Farm
outline.description: Dovecote. Probably late medieval or C16. Local stone rubble walls and corbelled domed roof with opening at the top. Round plan.

field_evidence: Official Planning Data listed-building-outline entity 42146923 is authoritative, names Hardwick Dovecote at Hardwick Farm, supplies a MultiPolygon, and explicitly describes a dovecote of probable late-medieval or C16 date; official Historic England list entry 1319610 names Dovecote at Hardwick Farm, uses legacy reference 740-1/47/536, identifies grade II*, and repeats the same dovecote description.
